A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same PathWise study. Their text, equations, figures, tables, and Appendices A–J support reliable comparison, including matching retained material across pagination and table-number changes.

before.justification: v1 reports original benchmark comparisons, convergence experiments, component and hyperparameter ablations, and computational-cost results in Section 4 and the appendices.

after.justification: v3 retains those original experiments and adds DeepSeek-V3.2 evaluations and six-run statistical comparisons in Appendix E.

M1.justification: The policy/world-model/critic architecture, entailment updates, population management, and diversity mechanisms are unchanged. The training-free clarification and removal of a redundant self-assignment in Algorithm 2 do not alter the procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate TSP, KP, CVRP, MKP, OP, and online/offline BPP, including TSPLIB and larger-instance tests. The new experiments reuse existing TSP-ACO and KP-Constructive coverage; DeepSeek-V3.2 changes the model configuration.

E2.justification: The added Appendix E comparisons use narrower comparator sets: ReEvo and HSEvo for TSP-ACO, and MCTS-AHD for KP-Constructive. MCTS-AHD is explicitly excluded from the added TSP comparisons because of runtime. The original broader comparisons remain.

E3.justification: v3 adds DeepSeek-V3.2 evaluations and supplements the stated 500-evaluation budget with a six-hour per-run cap in Appendix D.2. This revises the reported stopping conditions, but does not establish that retained experiments were rerun; Table 17 still contains times exceeding six hours.

E4.justification: Appendix E adds a targeted robustness check of dependence on proprietary LLMs by evaluating DeepSeek-V3.2 on two retained tasks. Existing critic, diversity, and hyperparameter ablations, TSPLIB tests, and output case studies remain unchanged.

E5.justification: v1 reports repeated-run means and shaded convergence curves without significance tests. v3 adds dedicated six-independent-run analyses with standard deviations and one-sided t-test p-values for selected TSP-ACO and KP-Constructive comparisons in Tables 12–13, substantially expanding statistical validation.

E6.justification: Tables 11–13 add results while retaining the original numerical tables. For DeepSeek-V3.2 TSP-ACO at N=100, gaps are 3.78% for PathWise, 6.40% for HSEvo, and 8.59% for ReEvo. New six-run estimates and significance outcomes supplement rather than replace the earlier three-run results.

T1.justification: The MDP and graph definitions, objectives, update equations, and mathematical formulations in the appendices are unchanged. The added explanation of training-free operation and pretrained world-model knowledge introduces no new formal assumptions, derivations, or proofs.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction's contribution statements, and conclusion retain the same claims about state-aware heuristic discovery, coordinated agents, diversity, convergence, and generalization. The added experiments support these existing claims.

C2.justification: Beyond v1's general discussion of stochastic variability, v3 identifies early-search randomness as a specific failure condition: some runs terminate before stable improvement emerges (Appendix I.1). It also interprets the DeepSeek results as evidence of applicability beyond proprietary models.

D1.justification: v3 adds a public-code URL, specifies exploration-rate endpoints of 0.5 and 0.25, and documents the time cap. Conversely, Appendix H removes the statement tying cost measurements to the Tables 1–2 runs and their fixed evaluation budget. Existing detailed prompts, algorithms, hardware, and dataset configurations remain.

R1.justification: v3 adds the DeepSeek-V3.2 reference and two Xiong et al. (2026) reasoning references in Appendix A.4. Research positioning remains largely unchanged; other reference edits update metadata for already cited works.

P1.justification: v3 adds short methodological clarifications, appendix introductions, acknowledgements, and conference publication text, and corrects the output-example cross-reference from Appendix I to G. The main narrative and section organization are retained.

P2.justification: v3 adds three appendix tables, including standard-deviation and p-value columns, with accompanying reflow and table renumbering. Existing figures and result displays remain substantially intact, with limited caption and spacing adjustments.

improvement.justification: The added uncertainty analyses and open-source-backbone results strengthen selected empirical comparisons, while code-access information, explicit parameters, and a more specific failure discussion improve reproducibility and transparency. Gains are limited by restricted task/comparator coverage and reporting inconsistencies: the new six-hour cap conflicts with retained 6.40- and 7.32-hour entries in Table 17, and the cost results lose their explicit connection to the main experimental runs.
